concerns.text: No task creates the independent Oracle Policy Engine required by FR‑008. Several consumer tasks (T102, T104, T106) depend on this producer, violating the producer‑before‑consumer rule.

No task implements the tokenizer wrapper mandated by FR‑009. Tasks that record token counts or enforce token‑name consistency (e.g., T104, T105) lack a defined producer, breaking the dependency ordering.
